notes.content:
• Added Strike.X website (sell your inventory)

 • Added a test branch (right click game title > properties > betas > "test_branch"). Feel free to try out the test branch to see the latest experimental changes and updates.

 • Added Steam achievement

 • "Fixed" Pathfinding (again)

 • Added LGBT Pride Mode (as requested by User SmokerOvWeed420). Toggle on in main menu graphics settings.

 • Rebalanced Rug.pull

 • Decreased Lucky 6 win-rate

notes.title: Day 1 Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
Fixed Game Breaking UI locks  

Added warning for version mismatch on save files (should be safe with this update)

Can now give fish items without having to go through their options menu. 

Gave the trashcan a menu for manual trash removal (in case you're bad at throwing)

Adjusted the sound of the shotgun in adventure mode. 

Small QOL fixes on the tutorial  

Movement speed in house increased for Simulation mode

Secret thing.

Increased winning odds of Lucky 6

  More fixes are coming, we appreciate the feedback and love you! <3
